headlines.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump’s Bid to Restrict Mail-in Ballot Rules
headlines.description: The Supreme Court on Monday rejected President Donald Trump’s efforts to restrict mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections in November. NBC’s Laura Jarrett joins TODAY to break down what’s at stake with the decision.

headlines.title: Trump’s handpicked Kennedy Center board again votes to close venue, calling it ‘unsafe’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s handpicked Kennedy Center board voted Tuesday to immediately shutter the performing arts center, a source familiar with the decision said, after its members argued the institution is in “dire” financial and structural shape.

headlines.title: U.S. and China face grave AI risks but mutual distrust stalls cooperation
headlines.description: The United States and China are both gripped by safety fears as they reckon with their rapid advances in AI, but intensifying competition and deep mutual distrust could derail the kind of cooperation experts say is vital to head off the strategically vital technology’s greatest dangers.

headlines.title: Nick Reiner prosecutors won’t seek death penalty in the killing of parents Rob and Michele Reiner, DA says
headlines.description: LOS ANGELES — Prosecutors will not seek the death penalty against Nick Reiner, charged with murder in the killings of his parents Rob and Michelle Reiner, after consulting with the victims’ loved ones, officials said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Robert Kraft Defends Dropping Macklemore From Ed Sheeran Tour
headlines.description: In a statement on Instagram, Grammy-winning musician Macklemore says he was forced out of Ed Sheeran’s “Loop Tour,” after Patriots owner Robert Kraft organized a boycott among stadium owners to get him removed over his on-stage pro-Palestine remarks. Kraft says he made that demand in part, “based on Macklemore’s recent actions…and a broader history of antisemitic rhetoric.” NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Russia and Ukraine launch new energy attacks despite Trump’s ceasefire claim
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine had agreed to stop striking each other’s energy infrastructure.

headlines.title: Putin-linked Russian oligarch paid for Donald Trump Jr.’s lavish island wedding party
headlines.description: The president’s eldest son and his wife, Bettina Trump, said Umar Kremlev “very generously hosted two incredible nights of celebrations” after their wedding.

headlines.title: Trump Weighs in On Scrutiny Surrounding Son’s Recent Wedding
headlines.description: Donald Trump Jr. and his wife Bettina, confirm that Umar Kremlev, a Russian oligarch with ties to Vladimir Putin and sanctioned by Ukraine, helped pay for celebrations following their May wedding in the Bahamas. President Donald Trump, who did not attend the wedding events, says he “never heard of” Kremlev and called it “not a big deal!”

headlines.title: Watch highlights of the 2026 Emmy Awards in 3 minutes
headlines.description: Apple TV's "Widow's Bay", "Pluribus," and HBO’s "The Pitt" received major awards at the 2026 Emmy Awards, with horror-comedy "Widow's Bay" taking home some of the night’s biggest awards, including outstanding comedy series, outstanding directing, outstanding lead actor Matthew Rhys, and outstanding supporting actress for Kate O’Flynn.

headlines.title: Emmys 2026 red carpet and winners: Matthew Rhys, Jean Smart, and more
headlines.description: On TV’s biggest night, the stars are coming out to shine.

headlines.title: The 2026 Emmys air tonight. Here’s what to expect, how to watch and who’s hosting.
headlines.description: Hollywood’s biggest night in television is back after a year of new beginnings. The 2026 Emmys will take place Monday, Sept. 14, at 8 p.m. ET.

headlines.title: U.S. has weapons in space, Air Force secretary says
headlines.description: Air Force Secretary Troy Meink confirmed that the U.S. has “on-orbit space control weapons” capable of defending “against hostile adversary actions.” NBC News’ Courtney Kube breaks down what kind of weapons could be used in space.
